description.value: Wang's Taiwanese Beef Noodle House is a Taiwanese and Chinese cuisine restaurant on Granville Street in Vancouver, specializing in beef brisket noodle soups, dim sum, and rice dishes. The menu spans over two dozen noodle variations — from classic red-braised beef brisket to spicy Sichuan dan dan noodles — alongside dumplings, pot stickers, and Taiwanese street-food staples. Touring cyclists riding the Granville corridor will find a hearty, filling meal with online pickup ordering available.
